Fixture for #14378: the scrollable-region labels travel from the language
files through the after-body template to the page. `lang: fr` picks the code
label from `_language-fr.yml`. The `language:` override for the output label
holds `</script>`, which must not close the template's script element early.

## Wide code block {#wide-code}

```python
wide_code = "an_unbroken_token_that_cannot_wrap_and_overflows_mobile"
```
